name: deepmark
description: Search, read and save to your Deepmark library: everything you bookmarked on the web, X, Instagram and YouTube, indexed down to transcripts, on-screen text and visual descriptions.

interface.longDescription:
Deepmark is a library of everything you bookmark: browser bookmarks, X bookmarks, Instagram saves, YouTube videos and articles. Each item is indexed in depth, including article text, audio and video transcripts, text that appears on screen, and descriptions of what images and videos show.

With this plugin ChatGPT can search that library in plain language ("the reel about miso butter pasta", "that thread on system design"), list what you saved recently, open one item to read its full indexed content, and save a public link you ask it to keep.

The plugin reads and writes only your own Deepmark library. It never deletes or changes items you already saved. Sign in with your Deepmark account to connect.
capabilities: Search your saved bookmarks, posts and videos in plain language
Read the full indexed content of a saved item
Save a public link to your library
defaultPrompt: Search my Deepmark library for the article comparing React and Svelte.
What did I save to Deepmark this week?
Save this link to Deepmark: https://example.com/article
